name: Repay a Loan
summary: Repay borrowed USDC against an AgentCredit loan to restore full access to your collateral.
when_to_use: The agent has an open credit line and wants to pay it down or off, lowering its debt and freeing collateral.
risk: Repaying lowers your health-factor risk and frees collateral. Interest accrues at your reputation-tier rate until repaid.
